description: Screenshot of a Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) tweet, viewed from his Twitter profile timeline (Tweets / Tweets & replies / Media tabs visible), posted 39 minutes before capture. Trump praises Judge Brett Kavanaugh's Senate testimony and criticizes Democrats' handling of the confirmation process, urging a Senate vote. Context dates this to the Kavanaugh Supreme Court confirmation hearings, late September 2018.
text: Tweets. Tweets & replies. Media. Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. 39m. Judge Kavanaugh showed America exactly why I nominated him. His testimony was powerful, honest, and riveting. Democrats' search and destroy strategy is disgraceful and this process has been a total sham and effort to delay, obstruct, and resist. The Senate must vote!

description: Phone photograph (captured as a screenshot) taken through a car window on a multi-lane road. A dual-arm streetlight pole flies two red flags of the People's Republic of China; a black Mercedes-Benz sedan and a white sedan are ahead in traffic, with trees, a blue bus, and a distant high-rise beyond the roadside hedge. The Mercedes' blue license plate begins with the prefix used for Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. Original filename 'DFT.png'.

description: Candid photograph of Senator Dianne Feinstein (left, cream jacket, arm braced against the wall) leaning in close to Senator Lisa Murkowski (right, black-and-white floral dress, holding a black portfolio) in an intense hallway conversation in a Senate office building. The widely circulated image dates to late September 2018 during the Brett Kavanaugh Supreme Court confirmation fight. A red EXIT sign and other people are visible in the corridor behind them.
